name: Developer tool landing
summary: A floating pill nav over a grid hero with circuit traces, an install command beside the one action, a typed terminal, tabbed code, six plain features, an API teaser, figures, one customer quote and a closing band.
anatomy: Pill nav → hero (announcement, headline, action + install command) → quickstart + terminal → SDK code → the parts as real fragments (code, a held response, a replay, keys, regions, one figure) → API endpoints → figures → quote → CTA → footer
type: workbench: a light, technical grotesk with a mono beside it, for a tool people use at a desk all day rather than a heavy developer-brand look
motion: No scroll moment: developers read code and copy commands, so nothing moves under them. Sections rise into place; the four figures in the numbers band count once to their true values (number-settle).
